messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Cyclobenzaprine is a prescription muscle relaxant.
It is used short-term to relieve muscle spasms.
The spasms are caused by sprains, strains, and injuries.
These include low back and neck pain.
Cyclobenzaprine is used together with rest and physical therapy.
This combination helps relieve pain, tenderness, and limited movement.
These symptoms are caused by muscle spasm.
1,2
Cyclobenzaprine is also used to treat fibromyalgia in adults.
Cyclobenzaprine can help reduce pain.
For fibromyalgia, Cyclobenzaprine is taken as a sublingual (under the tongue) tablet at bedtime under the brand name Tonmya.
In clinical trials, Tonmya significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks.
Close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain.
3
The Flexeril brand has been discontinued.
Cyclobenzaprine is available as generic tablets.
Cyclobenzaprine is also available as the brand-name products Amrix (extended-release capsules) and Fexmid.
2,4
Triples: [["Cyclobenzaprine", "is a", "prescription muscle relaxant"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "used for", "relieve muscle spasms"], ["muscle spasms", "caused by", "sprains"], ["muscle spasms", "caused by", "strains"], ["muscle spasms", "caused by", "injuries"], ["muscle spasms", "include", "low back and neck pain"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "used in combination with", "rest"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "used in combination with", "physical therapy"], ["combination of Cyclobenzaprine with rest and physical therapy", "helps relieve", "pain"], ["combination of Cyclobenzaprine with rest and physical therapy", "helps relieve", "tenderness"], ["combination of Cyclobenzaprine with rest and physical therapy", "helps relieve", "limited movement"], ["pain, tenderness, and limited movement", "caused by", "muscle spasm"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "used to treat", "fibromyalgia in adults"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "can help reduce", "pain"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "administered via", "sublingual tablet"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "taken at", "bedtime"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has brand name", "Tonmya"], ["Tonmya", "has administration instruction", "taken as sublingual tablet at bedtime"], ["Tonmya", "has indication", "treat fibromyalgia"], ["Tonmya", "has clinical trial result", "significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks"], ["Tonmya", "has clinical trial result", "close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain"], ["Flexeril", "has status", "discontinued"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "available as", "generic tablets"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has brand name", "Amrix"], ["Amrix", "has dosage form", "extended-release capsules"], ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has brand name", "Fexmid"]]
Relations: ["administered via", "available as", "can help reduce", "caused by", "has administration instruction", "has brand name", "has clinical trial result", "has dosage form", "has indication", "has status", "helps relieve", "include", "is a", "taken at", "used for", "used in combination with", "used to treat"]
Answer:

completion:
is a: The subject entity is classified as or identified as the object entity.
used for: The subject drug is used to achieve the purpose or effect specified by the object entity.
caused by: The object entity is the underlying cause or reason for the subject entity.
include: The object entity is an example or subset of the subject entity.
used in combination with: The subject drug is used in conjunction with the object entity to achieve a therapeutic effect.
helps relieve: The subject combination or treatment is effective in reducing or alleviating the symptoms or conditions specified by the object entity.
can help reduce: The subject drug has the potential to decrease or alleviate the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
administered via: The subject drug is given or delivered through the route or method specified by the object entity.
taken at: The subject drug is administered or used at the time or condition specified by the object entity.
has administration instruction: The subject drug has specific instructions for its administration, as specified by the object entity.
has brand name: The subject drug is marketed or sold under the brand name specified by the object entity.
has clinical trial result: The subject drug has demonstrated the clinical outcome or result specified by the object entity in trials.
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the specific pharmaceutical form specified by the object entity.
has indication: The subject drug is approved or used for the medical condition or purpose specified by the object entity.
has status: The subject entity has the status or condition specified by the object entity.
available as: The subject drug is available in the form or formulation specified by the object entity.
